rules.statement: Where two parties have acquired the whole interest of a shareholder in certain proportions, and their deeds describe the interest of such a shareholder as an undivided interest, and it transpires that a specific portion of the land has, in fact, been held by the person through whom they both claim as his portion for the prescriptive period, this specific portion must be divided in the same proportions as those described in their deeds.
rules.supporting_quote: Where, however, two parties have acquired the whole interest of a shareholder in certain proportions, and their deeds describe the interest of such a shareholder as an undivided interest, and it transpires that a specific portion of the land has, in fact, been held by the person through whom they both claim as his portion for the prescriptive period, and the question then arises as to the proportion in which that specific portion has to be divided, it seems to ma that justice requires that, as between those parties, this specific portion must be divided in the same proportions as those described in their deeds.
